page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, with page number at right. Title block, then the Caput Primum heading, then the main text column on the left. A narrow margin on the right holds the marginal notes. Signature "A" and catchword "fun-" at the foot.

main_text.head: OTHONIS CAS-MANNI PHYSIOLOGIÆ NUCLEUS seu CORPORUM NA-TURALIUM PÆDAGOGI-CUM ET METHODICUM Systema. LIBER PRIMUS.Natura.
CAPUT PRIMUM. DE CORPORE NA-TURALI.
main_text.p: MateriaPhysica seu Physiologia.PHYSICA seu PHYSIOLO-GIA est doctrina corporum naturalium.
Corpus naturale.CORPUS NATURALE est, quod sua constat Naturâ.

p.i: Corpus est substantia materiata, sensilis, mobilis, quantitate continua per se terminata.
Hæc substantia, si habet sibi à Deo inditam Naturam, qua est efficax ad sibi delegatas

page.notes: The large woodcut initial P is joined to "HYSICA" in the first paragraph. The top margin note "Natura." sits beside the title and is faint; placed in the head. "Materia" in the margin beside the first paragraph is faint and uncertain. The fourth margin note near "Hæc substantia" is faint and read as "Corporis naturalis significatio" with doubt. Faint margin text near the middle of the right margin ("Naturæ efficax" and similar) is not clear enough to read and is left out. Show-through from the reverse side and the faint marks at the bottom left and right are not printed text on this page and are left out. The catchword "fun-" is the start of the next page's first word.
